description: This file contains shell functions for managing Git repository states, including setting, saving, verifying, and checking the head revision. It appears to be a test utility script for Git-related operations.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Prepares the worktree and index with specified content for a given path.

methods.name: save_state
methods.description: Saves the current worktree and index content of a file into auxiliary snapshot files.

methods.name: set_and_save_state
methods.description: Sets the state and then saves it by calling set_state and save_state in sequence.

methods.name: verify_state
methods.description: Verifies the content of a file against expected worktree and index contents.

methods.name: verify_saved_state
methods.description: Verifies the saved state of a file against the last stored snapshots.

methods.name: save_head
methods.description: Saves the current HEAD revision hash into a file.

methods.name: verify_saved_head
methods.description: Verifies that the current HEAD matches the saved hash.
